title: A widening option's card says the uniform ruling in plain words, not a bare id
why: Incident (shiv, Nov 1 11:43 CST, page item 114): "what was my uniform ruling (t18)? ... it should never just quote a variable to me like that and expect me to understand". The card text 'Goes against your uniform ruling (t18)' cites a bare topic id, against rule speak-cite-id-plus-gloss.
note: Triage judged it a debt with an incident (roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes): every widening option shows the bare id. Fix the cause in one home: the card text says what the ruling is, for example 'Goes against your ruling that a repo matches a shared tool, never the tool bending for one repo'. The text lives in skills/waiting-page/page.html; hooks/question_form.py WIDENS_MARK, the output style rule style-question-form, skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md and hooks/test_question_form.py read the same words, so they move together.
